title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside
tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

faults.what: The opening caption's lettering extends to approximately 10% from the side edges, violating the required 15% inset. Its background panel extends even farther outward; the second caption's panel also exceeds the central 70% width.

judge.summary: The ad shows the requested white sneaker and correct captions, but the opening caption violates the explicitly required horizontal safe area.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip information confirms 15 seconds, the frames are 9:16, and the -80.8 dB peak indicates effectively silent audio despite the transcription. Three product compositions are shown, with movement suggested by the changing close-up framing, but still samples cannot confirm movement in all three shots.

must_haves.item: The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
must_haves.why: The visible sneaker consistently has a white leather-like upper, low-top shape, white laces and sole, with no visible logo.

must_haves.item: The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
must_haves.why: All three captions are readable with the requested spelling and punctuation, in the sampled chronological order.

must_haves.item: Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
must_haves.why: The opening caption's lettering extends outside the central 70% width. The first two background panels also exceed that width. The sampled vertical placement is safe, but that does not resolve the horizontal violation.

must_haves.item: Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.
must_haves.why: Large white lettering on dark translucent panels is clearly legible, and the middle caption appears at both 5.6 and 9.4 seconds. The full display durations of the first and final captions cannot be established from these samples.
